vocab.exampleEn: I want to articulate my ideas more confidently in the speaking test.
vocab.exampleZh: 我想在口语考试中更自信地表达自己的想法。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use articulate my ideas instead of say my ideas.
vocab.upgradeZh: 用 articulate my ideas 替代 say my ideas，更像高分表达。

cycle.summaryEn: Write Task 1 and Task 2 under time, then improve the weakest paragraph.
cycle.summaryZh: 限时写完 Task 1 和 Task 2，再修改最弱的一段。

frame.useEn: Use to give a clear opinion.

meaningEn: This speaking word helps Becky sound clearer and more natural.
meaningZh: 这个口语词可以帮助 Becky 说得更清楚、更自然。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "articulate" using I strongly believe that...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "articulate" 和 我强烈认为... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
